title: Machine Learning
description:
Machine Learning – Job Description

Responsibilities

Develop, train, and evaluate machine learning models for real-world problems.
Collect, clean, preprocess, and analyze datasets.
Perform feature engineering and select suitable algorithms.
Build and improve predictive models using machine learning techniques.
Test model performance using appropriate evaluation metrics.
Work with Python libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, and Matplotlib.
Collaborate with developers and data teams to integrate ML models into applications.
Document experiments, results, and model performance.
Continuously research and learn new machine learning techniques.

Required Skills

Good understanding of Machine Learning concepts and algorithms.
Knowledge of supervised and unsupervised learning.
Proficiency in Python.
Knowledge of NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, and Scikit-learn.
Basic understanding of statistics and probability.
Knowledge of data preprocessing and visualization.
Understanding of model evaluation techniques such as accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and confusion matrix.
Basic knowledge of SQL and databases.
Problem-solving and analytical thinking.
Good communication and teamwork skills.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
Knowledge of programming fundamentals and data structures.
Academic or personal projects involving Machine Learning are preferred.
Familiarity with Git/GitHub is an advantage.
Knowledge of Deep Learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch is an added advantage.
